# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church wasn't a suggestion—it was a battle cry. "Act like men" carries the weight of courage, responsibility, and resolve. In a world that rewards comfort and calls passivity "peace," God calls His sons to stand firm. Notice the order: be watchful first. A man who isn't paying attention gets ambushed—by temptation, by laziness, by the slow drift from what matters. Then stand firm. Not stand casually, not stand until it gets hard. Firm. Rooted. Immovable. And finally, be strong. Not in your own power, but in the strength that flows from faith in Christ. Real strength isn't loud. It's the quiet discipline of a man who shows up day after day, keeps his word, protects what's entrusted to him, and refuses to quit when the pressure rises. Today you'll face a dozen small choices. Each one is a chance to act like a man of God.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, pausing at the top of each rep to say, "I stand firm in the faith."
